subtitle: My Creative Works
description: A curated collection of recent web applications and design projects I've crafted.

projects.title: DevMetrics Analytics Dashboard
projects.tagline: Real-time developer analytics platform displaying build metrics & performance.
projects.description: A real-time developer analytics platform displaying build metrics, deployments, and team collaboration statistics with interactive visualizations.
projects.fullDescription: DevMetrics is an enterprise-grade analytics dashboard designed to empower developer teams with real-time insight into CI/CD pipelines, repository velocity, build success rates, and team productivity metrics. Built with modern web architecture, it transforms complex log outputs into actionable visual telemetry.
projects.problemStatement: Engineering managers and team leads struggled to get unified real-time visibility across fragmented CI/CD tools, leading to delayed deployments and unmonitored pipeline bottlenecks.
projects.solutionOverview: Created a centralized liquid-glass telemetry dashboard that aggregates WebSocket events from GitHub Actions and Jenkins, rendering interactive GPU-accelerated charts with sub-second latency.

keyFeatures.title: Real-Time Telemetry Streaming
keyFeatures.description: Live WebSocket data streams showing active deployment status, server CPU usage, and build queues.

keyFeatures.title: Interactive Data Visualizations
keyFeatures.description: Custom high-contrast charts featuring drill-down filters for repository and team performance.

keyFeatures.title: Automated Alerting Engine
keyFeatures.description: Instant notifications delivered to Slack and Webhooks upon build failure detection.

keyFeatures.title: Role-Based Team Workspaces
keyFeatures.description: Granular permissions for engineering leads, developers, and DevOps administrators.

architecture.frontend: React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI, Chart.js, Lucide Icons

projects.challengesAndLearnings: Handling high-frequency WebSocket bursts without triggering React render lag required implementing throttled state updates and virtualized data table rendering.

projects.title: Zenith E-Commerce Platform
projects.tagline: Next-generation liquid storefront featuring instant search and frictionless checkout.
projects.description: A modern storefront featuring instant search, dynamic cart management, order tracking, and seamless checkout integration.
projects.fullDescription: Zenith E-Commerce is a high-converting digital storefront built to redefine mobile-first online shopping. Featuring instant fuzzy search, glassmorphic interactive product previews, dynamic inventory management, and one-click payment processing via Stripe.
projects.problemStatement: Traditional e-commerce templates suffered from slow page transitions, clunky cart drawers, and high drop-off rates during multi-step checkout flows.
projects.solutionOverview: Engineered an ultra-fast headless storefront with optimistic UI updates for instant cart manipulation, client-side caching, and streamlined single-screen checkout.

keyFeatures.title: Instant Fuzzy Search
keyFeatures.description: Sub-20ms search indexing allowing users to find items instantly with zero page reload.

keyFeatures.title: Optimistic Cart Management
keyFeatures.description: Zero-latency item addition with automatic synchronized persistence across browser tabs.

keyFeatures.title: Stripe & Digital Wallet Pay
keyFeatures.description: Seamless integration with Stripe Checkout, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

keyFeatures.title: Dynamic Product Variant Matrix
keyFeatures.description: Interactive color swatches, dynamic pricing, and stock status updates in real time.

architecture.frontend: React 19, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion

projects.challengesAndLearnings: Ensuring smooth cart drawer animations alongside instantaneous state synchronization across multiple tabs was solved using BroadcastChannel web APIs and Redux state sync.

projects.title: Aura Component Design System
projects.tagline: Comprehensive Liquid Glass UI system with full accessibility and micro-interactions.
projects.description: A comprehensive UI component library focused on accessibility (a11y), smooth micro-animations, and fluid responsive design tokens.
projects.fullDescription: Aura is a design system built around the Apple Liquid Glass design language. It supplies production-ready UI components—ranging from specular-corner cards to liquid tabs and glowing buttons—built with strict WAI-ARIA compliance and dark mode adaptability.
projects.problemStatement: Development teams spent excessive engineering hours rebuilding custom glassmorphism styles, resulting in inconsistent UI patterns and broken screen reader accessibility.
projects.solutionOverview: Designed a cohesive design token architecture with automated Tailwind utilities, ARIA-compliant primitive wrappers, and interactive Storybook documentation.

keyFeatures.title: Liquid Glass Design Tokens
keyFeatures.description: Tailwind utilities for backdrop blur, specular highlights, and ambient glass borders.

keyFeatures.title: WAI-ARIA Accessibility
keyFeatures.description: Built on top of Radix UI primitives ensuring full keyboard accessibility and screen reader support.

keyFeatures.title: Dark Mode & Color Themes
keyFeatures.description: Automatic system dark mode detection with seamless HSL token dynamic swapping.

keyFeatures.title: Interactive Storybook Workbench
keyFeatures.description: Live component playground with automated visual regression testing.

architecture.frontend: React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI Primitives
architecture.distribution: npm package release, CSS Utility Module

projects.challengesAndLearnings: Balancing complex CSS backdrop filters with high-performance 60fps scrolling on mobile devices required optimizing hardware-accelerated composite layers.

projects.title: Nexus Task & Workspace Manager
projects.tagline: Collaborative project workspace featuring Kanban boards and real-time synchronization.
projects.description: A collaborative workspace tool with kanban boards, drag-and-drop task management, real-time updates, and team permissions.
projects.fullDescription: Nexus is an intuitive project management suite built for agile product teams. It combines fluid drag-and-drop Kanban boards, task assignment workflows, automated status tracking, and inline comment threads into an elegant Liquid Glass workspace.
projects.problemStatement: Clunky project management platforms slowed team handoffs and suffered from visual clutter that hindered daily task focus.
projects.solutionOverview: Built a streamlined Kanban interface with drag-and-drop touch support, real-time sync, and custom view filters.

keyFeatures.title: Fluid Kanban Drag & Drop
keyFeatures.description: Smooth touch-friendly drag-and-drop card movement across workflow columns.

keyFeatures.title: Real-Time Collaboration
keyFeatures.description: Live cursor presence and instant card updates across all team members.

keyFeatures.title: Custom Field & Tag System
keyFeatures.description: Flexible task categorization with priority badges, deadlines, and assignees.

keyFeatures.title: Integrated Markdown Editor
keyFeatures.description: Rich task descriptions with embedded code blocks, checklists, and attachments.

architecture.frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, dnd-kit

projects.challengesAndLearnings: Maintaining smooth card reordering animations while persisting column position mutations to MongoDB without race conditions.
